notes.title: Patch 1.04
notes.notes: Fixed bug where only the first card looted was being checked for achievements.

notes.title: Patch 1.03
notes.notes: Improved consistency of Steam Achievement activations.

notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.notes:
[olist]
 Fixed possible UI bug caused by pressing ESC key during transition to Crafting.
 Resistances now correctly update when collecting Stones.
 Traps in Odia's Gauntlet now correctly trigger SFX.
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.notes:
All Save Points in the end game should now correctly allow crafting of the full range of card values possible.
 Improved drop rate of Rare Staff and Health Potion cards
 Fixed Typos

notes.title: V0.204 Update
notes.notes:
Added options in settings to enable/disable render effects.
 Settings data saves and loads correctly.
 RGB Shift render effect no longer applied to UI text to improve legibility.
 Added feedback to main menu buttons.
 Tooltip UI Alpha changed
 Deckbuilder card reward no longer appears behind skip button.
 Paladin Unbreakable Level 1 skill has been reworked to add bonus to Max AC as well as Fortitude.
